class Solution:
    def addTwoNumbers(self, l1: ListNode, l2: ListNode) -> ListNode:
        dummy = ListNode(0)
        tail = dummy
        carry = 0
        while l1 or l2 or carry:
            total = carry
            if l1:
                total += l1.val
                l1 = l1.next
            if l2:
                total += l2.val
                l2 = l2.next
            tail.next = ListNode(total % 10)
            tail = tail.next
            carry = total // 10
        return dummy.next
